feature: Ask makes icons that are icons
summary: Ask an icon and you get a few clean named shapes in a square picture of its own. A balloon popping now reads as one, and you can tweak an icon in words: make it outline or filled, thicker or thinner lines, a colour, in place, with one Undo.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walks: ask-makes-an-icon-walk, ask-puts-an-icon-in-its-own-picture-walk, new-image-icon-sizes-walk, ask-tweaks-an-icon-walk.

evaluate: Does the balloon read as popping to you, at 64 and at 24 pixels?
When you say make it filled, is a white line for the flap what you expected?
Is the tear at the upper right right for a balloon, or should it sit somewhere else?
Do the trash can, search and padlock icons look like they belong beside SF Symbols?
Is the plain dark outline the right look when you name no style?
rough: The balloon reached its bar on three readings of four: did what was asked and reads as an icon 8 and 7, 8 and 7, 7 and 6, 8 and 7, scores 88.8, 88, 85.6 and 88.8, named 3 of 3 each. The shipped code before it read 55.4 and 25.8. The miss is one point on one reading, on a knot the model drew clumsily.

The held-out set fell: 62.7 over all 45 cases, against 68.4 before. Drawing cases that ran out of time went from 1 to 4 of 36, which is about 4.7 of the 5.7 points, and the 3 redline cases read 33.8 against 44.1. Median request time did not move and prompts for anything but an icon did not change, but why those ran out is not known yet: filed as find-out-why-the-held-out-set-lost-points-on-202.

The tear suits some objects better than others. One reading each, tear off then on: heart 30.5 to 55.4, egg 84.8 to 70.6, bubble 71.3 to 54.8. A broken heart looks bitten, not cracked, and a bubble was named a cracked egg 2 of 3. Filed as a-broken-icon-reads-as-what-breaks-it-a-crack-th.
Every break tears at the upper right and looks the same, whatever is breaking. Asked if an object is breaking, the model answered rightly on all 19 requests tried, but that was one try each.
A cut made by filling is plain white, so it is white on a dark picture too, not a real hole. Left in the task log.
Rounder corners on an icon is still done part by part, and reads as moderate: it passed at 7 on matching the words, the same as smaller on the balloon's knot.
The 14 original icon cases read 90.8, up from 88.3, reads as an icon 7.6; all 17 read 85.4 with the three new breaking objects in.
Ask's model writes one SVG that lands as shape and path layers, rather than one add_shape or add_path call per part as the task said. The layers are the same kind and it is one undo step.
The numbers in an icon's SVG are fractions, because a 24 grid does not divide into 512. The file is clean paths with no picture.
No mock covers where an icon lands or how it is tweaked; where it lands is the user's own rule, from 2026-11-04.
